notes: SagerNet publishes no prebuilt libbox AAR on Maven Central, JitPack or GitHub Releases; it is built from source by .github/workflows/android-libbox.yml.
The third-party mirror com.github.singbox-android:libbox is deliberately NOT used: an unaffiliated publisher's unreproducible binary would run inside the VPN process with full traffic visibility.

sha256 records the AAR produced by the pinned toolchain above. gomobile output is not bit-reproducible across hosts even with -trimpath -buildvcs=false -buildid=, so a mismatch is a signal to re-verify provenance, not proof of tampering. The invariants that ARE enforced in CI are the source tag, the single arm64-v8a ABI and the presence of jni/arm64-v8a/libbox.so.
